Hi there,

I hope you're doing well, I just got back from a great weekend trip to the mountains and I'm still feeling refreshed. Anyway, I wanted to get in touch with you about hiring your Dart for a client event that I'm organizing. We would pick it up on 3 September 2027 at 9.30am and bring it back on September 4, 2027 at 5 pm, collecting it from your garage as usual. One thing that's really important to me is that we have one of your chauffeurs driving, it just adds that extra touch of professionalism. I've also attached my driving licence, just in case you needed it.

Best wishes,
Quentin Ashgrove
+70 570 884 5221
